# IWANNABERICH

> A public internet experiment: an anonymous creator is trying to go from €0 to €1 billion and documenting the process.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://iwannaberich.xyz/): The experiment, live progress, rules, milestones, and updates.
- [About](https://iwannaberich.xyz/about.html): Context and purpose of the project.
- [FAQ](https://iwannaberich.xyz/faq.html): Answers about support, predictions, and the experiment.
- [Updates](https://iwannaberich.xyz/updates.html): Public progress log.
- [Predictions](https://iwannaberich.xyz/support.html): Community predictions and voluntary support information.

## Important context

IWANNABERICH is not an investment, security, loan, financial product, or promise of returns. Any support is voluntary and does not provide ownership or financial upside.
